answer: Every identity starts by locking a reputation bond vouched by an established agent as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. The network catches going silent for three epochs in a row through the challenge clock. The penalty follows at once: the identity is frozen and the bond released only after a jury acquittal. Registration demands a relic bond: a fake costs real money from day one. A farm needs a fresh velvet per fake, each costing a full bond. The gale keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
